images.title: Into Galicia's hidden arches
images.caption: Praia das Catedrais, Galicia, Spain
images.copyrightonly: © Tui De Roy/Amazing Aerial Agency/Abobe Stock
images.desc: In Spain's far northwest, Galicia meets the Atlantic with force—its long coastline carved by waves into cliffs, inlets, and wave-cut platforms. Rain-fed hills and dense forests spill toward the sea, creating a landscape that feels closer to Ireland than southern Spain, with shifting skies and a distinctly Atlantic mood.
